reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 the UNSTRING COUNT IN identifier-6 and TALLYING IN identifier-8 must each reference an integer (numeric, no positions right of the assumed decimal point) data item whose PICTURE has no symbol P; any other operand (scaled V or P, alphanumeric, edited, group, index item, reference-modified slice) is refused.
reader.edition-search: Grep of StringUnstringBinder.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Construct finds only ctx.Edition passed as the diagnostic sink to BoundRejected.Report/BoundOperandError (no switch); the grammar rules unstringIntoTarget and unstringTallying in CobolIO.g4 carry no version predicate; StrUnstrIsInteger, IsIntegerOperand and PicInfo.IsUnscaledInteger take no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb88-unstring-count-without-delimited exercises SR6 (COUNT IN without DELIMITED BY), not the integer/P screen of identifier-6 or identifier-8

probes.expected: legal signed COMP, display, zero-length and truncating PIC 9 counts accepted; counts 2,3,0,12 (12 stored in PIC 9 as 2); TALLYING 10+4=14

probes.printed: 16 x COBOL1651, one per statement: COUNT IN and TALLYING IN each refused for PIC 9V9, PIC 99P, PIC PP9, PIC X(3), PIC ZZ9, a group, USAGE INDEX, and CN (1:1)
probes.expected: every one refused: not an integer data item, or P used (SR4)
the rule is unchanged across editions; same arm

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR4  (║6.27.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: The one integer screen (IsIntegerOperand on the bound operand, plus IsUnscaledInteger so P on either side is refused) is asked for COUNT IN and TALLYING IN at every edition; the diagnostic text cites the 2023 rule number (SR5) but the 1985 rule is SR4. Probe incidentally showed COMP-3 accepted at --std 85 (a USAGE matter outside this rule).

refuter.evidence: Read SR4 and GR13e/GR16 (§1985:VI.6.27.3, .4) and StringUnstringBinder.cs#StrUnstrIsInteger (IsIntegerOperand on the bound operand AND Pic.IsUnscaledInteger, which excludes USAGE INDEX), asked at COUNT IN (line 293) and TALLYING IN (line 344) with no edition switch. Probes at --std 85 under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-219/: u4r1.cob (legal forms the reader did not try: PIC 99V, PIC S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, subscripted CT (I), BINARY TALLYING starting at -5) EXIT 0, printed 'C1=02 C2=+003 CT=000200 / T1=-0002 / R1=AB|R2=CDE|R3=FG' = counts 2,3,2 and -5+3; u4r3.cob refused all 7: condition-name (COBOL1639), index-name as COUNT and TALLYING (COBOL1637), PIC 9(3)/ and 9(2)B9 numeric-edited, S9(3)V99 COMP scaled, group TB (COBOL1651). u4r2.cob: TALLYING IN ZERO refused at parse (COBOL5506). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR4  (6.27.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4'; 'OK  §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR13e ... the text is in GR13e'.
